name: Band Seated Row
cues: Sit on the floor with legs straight and loop the band around your feet
Hold the ends with straight arms and sit tall
Pull your hands to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades
Let your arms extend slowly against the band

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Long sitting: knees 6, hip flexion 87 to 99 (trunk leans about 12 at the stretch), elbow 9 to 127. The fists finish at y 0.335 m beside the waist, about 0.19 m above lumbar1, with retraction prot -18. The band loops the balls of the feet (sole contact -10 mm, intended), stretches 1.10 to 2.45 m, and stays at least 37 mm off the thighs and trunk. thigh/trunk at -48 mm is inside the pair tolerance.
